raw_response:
The issuer shows strong profitability (net margin ~20.5% and EBIT margin ~33.2%) and substantial equity cushion (equity ~48% of total assets), which supports credit strength. However, liquidity is weak with a current ratio below 1 (1,047/1,322 ≈ 0.79) and leverage is not negligible (liabilities slightly exceed equity), which limits the rating.  

DECISION: BBB+
